data.title: 胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏
data.description: 【胡桃 · 翠竹幽径捉迷藏】轻策庄青翠葱郁的竹林小径上，斑驳的晨光洒在青石板上。胡桃身穿休闲毛衣与百褶短裙，倚在一根粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，将食指轻抵唇边做出噤声的手势，狡黠的大眼睛里满是想要吓人一跳的俏皮笑意——「嘘——！不要出声！本堂主这次一定要好好吓七七一跳！」
data.action: 倚在粗壮翠竹后探出半边身子，食指轻抵唇边做噤声手势，眼神充满恶作剧笑意
data.lighting: 竹叶缝隙漏下的斑驳明亮阳光
data.promptProse: Half concealed by a thick bamboo stalk, Hu Tao leans into the eye-level cowboy view with one index finger at her lips and her other hand against the stalk. Her dark sweater, red skirt and knee socks accompany a conspiratorial smile. The stone path curves behind her through closely spaced bamboo. Morning sun passes through leaf gaps, placing broken bright stripes on her sleeve and alternating shadows across the path.
